description: Hosted edge autocomplete for reference lists (countries, NAICS, airports, currencies): React, Next.js, Expo, HTML and an MCP server.
rules: Only autocomplete queries. Call GET /v1/query with the text the user typed. Never fetch, dump, export or download a whole list, and never enumerate one with sequential queries.
The publishable key goes in the key query parameter. Never send it in an Authorization header; that header is reserved for an optional access token on a protected list.
Minimum query length is 2 characters and is never 1. Send no request below the list's queryPolicy.minQueryChars.
Debounce 150 ms by default. Read the real value from queryPolicy.debounceMs; do not hardcode either number.
A list returns 10 suggestions by default. Render what is returned; do not page or request more.
Render displayValue, store value. Switch on the typed error code, never on a message string.
A failure is not "no results". Show an error state driven by the error code.
